competitor_context.headline: Ouster wins expanded Utah DOT BlueCity lidar contract, adds ~160 intersections after competitive evaluation
competitor_context.implication_for_target: Ouster's win shows lidar demand broadening beyond autonomous vehicles into smart-infrastructure/ITS, a market Hesai has not focused on — validates the sector but highlights a niche where Hesai has less presence.

competitor_context.headline: Mobileye upgraded to Buy from Hold at Berenberg (Aug 17, 2026) amid CEO succession process
competitor_context.implication_for_target: Mobileye's camera-centric ADAS approach is a direct philosophical rival to lidar-based systems; an upgrade suggests renewed investor interest in camera-only autonomy, a mild competitive headwind for lidar suppliers like Hesai.

summary_kr: 허사이는 2분기 매출·이익이 견조하게 성장했고 로봇 액추에이터 사업으로 '피지컬 AI' 부품업체로 영역을 넓히고 있지만, 실적 발표 직후 주가 하락과 골드만삭스의 목표주가 하향이 보여주듯 단기적으로는 밸류에이션과 성장 둔화 우려가 공존하는 국면이다.
